requirements_summary: Enterprise manufacturing telemetry vendor. Primary constraint: sensitive PII-adjacent telemetry + EU customer contracts require clear residency and strict key control. PoC scope: ingest 100k events/min, 95th pct latency <120ms for short chat-like anomaly queries, bulk embedding jobs for search at night. Must support VPC-only control plane, mTLS for all service-to-service traffic, audit logs forwarded to their Splunk instance, and customer-managed KMS/HSM (BYOK) with quarterly key rotation policy. Retention controls: 30/90/365 day tiers configurable per dataset.
notes:
- Key ask: full control of root keys (BYOK) + HSM-backed KMS; security wants formal HSM integration diagram.
- Encryption posture discussed in security call: require mTLS between Redwood control plane and workload plane, all inter-service traffic inside VPC encrypted, TLS 1.3 required.
- At-rest: strong preference for customer-managed keys for model KV cache and persistent storage; if Redwood-managed keys used, need automated key-rotation visibility and exportable rotation proofs.
- Key rotation: customer policy -> quarterly rotation for data plane keys; ability to perform emergency key revocation and re-wrap of stored secrets.
- Secrets management: integrate with HashiCorp Vault or Azure Key Vault; must support short-lived cert issuance and vault-backed secrets in K8s pods.
- Audit logging: deliverable = event stream to customer's Splunk + retained copy in Redwood for 90 days; logs must include token-level request id, model variant, routing fallback decisions.
- Data residency: plan to pin EU-model-serving nodes for EU customers; need data-at-rest residency SLA and documentation for sub-processing.
- Quote from CISO on 2026-02-18: "We need hardware roots of trust and visibility into rotation — no managed black boxes."
- PoC ask: end-to-end mTLS handshake trace, KMS encrypt/decrypt latency numbers, and a perf run showing batch vs. single-token latency under mTLS.
- Pricing sensitivity: willing to accept premium for Private with BYOK + HSM, but wants clear unit economics (tokens/embeds).
- Next: send combined security + network PoC checklist; legal to propose residency clause for SOW.
